name: Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules
issuing_organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
notes: Specifies security requirements for cryptographic modules in four increasing levels. FIPS 140-3 is the successor but 140-2 remains widely referenced.

derives_from.note: FISMA directs NIST to develop cryptographic standards.
Authorizes NIST to promulgate compulsory federal information security standards.
